components.html:
Inspect a contribution

Source candidates and compiler retention are separate evidence.

narrative.overview:
This records the shipped explorer, not a new visual identity proposal. The surface uses restrained system typography, native controls, quiet rules and compact evidence tables. Measurements lead; the inspector explains a single selection without creating an accumulating history.

Product truth constrains presentation: ownership, emission and retention must remain distinct. Unknown measurements and partial results are visible states, not decorative zeroes.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, readable measurement tables with tabular numeric alignment.
Bounded diagrams with accessible text equivalents.
Local assets, light/dark system themes and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Labelled Budget Rule
rules.body: Color never substitutes for the stream, byte measurement, evidence status or partial-result explanation.

dos: Do pair every chart with exact values and a text/keyboard equivalent.
Do preserve unknown, overlapping and partial evidence explicitly.
Do bound tables and diagrams independently of the original corpus size.
Do keep native controls, system theme adaptation and visible focus.
donts: Don't encode contributor bytes with graph degree or equal-size nodes.
Don't shrink labels to make a whole application graph appear to fit.
Don't use decorative motion in place of query progress or uncertainty.
Don't turn path/source text into an executable or arbitrary-file action.
